features.name: Mountain wall
features.note: Seals the valley. The gap on the west side lets the river and road through.

features.name: River
features.note: Rises as a spring or waterfall in the eastern mountains, runs through the lake and leaves by the western pass.

features.name: Enlarged lake
features.note: Today's lake is 20 m wide. The art shows a much larger one.

features.name: Arrival road
features.note: Follows the south bank and enters facing the fort.

features.name: Arrival gate
features.note: New north-west gate. It replaces the Civilization gate.

features.name: Palisade, south-west
features.note: Tall timber palisade. Openings are left where roads cross.

features.name: Palisade, west
features.note: Tall timber palisade. Openings are left where roads cross.

features.name: Palisade, north
features.note: Tall timber palisade. Openings are left where roads cross.

features.name: Palisade, east
features.note: Tall timber palisade. Openings are left where roads cross.

features.name: Palisade, south-east
features.note: Tall timber palisade. Openings are left where roads cross.

features.name: Palisade, south
features.note: Closes the ring behind the outcrop, south of the trough, so the back alley stays inside the camp.

features.name: Broken palisade
features.note: 8 m collapsed stretch of the north palisade. Keeps the hunter's fire in view from the tents; it stays closed to walking.

features.name: Docks
features.note: Company docks on the camp bank. Off-limits at night.

features.name: Ford
features.note: Shallow crossing for the wilderness path.

features.name: Hunter's fire
features.note: Must be seen from the docks and tents at night.

features.name: Wilderness trail
features.note: Runs from the camp exit over the ford to the hunting grounds.

features.name: Ruins
features.note: On a raised ridge across the river. Must be seen from camp by day.

features.name: Hunting grounds
features.note: Work site, north of the river.

features.name: Stone quarry
features.note: Work site on high ground. Holds the sealed passage.

features.name: Quarry road
features.note: Workers walk this every morning.

features.name: Wood camp
features.note: Work site in the west forest.

features.name: Wood camp road
features.note: Branches west from the camp.

features.name: Fight Club Hollow
features.note: Crater rim is the back wall; a rock fold along its south edge hides it from the fort.

features.name: Ruins 2
features.note: Extra ruins in and hidden around the quarry. The sealed passage connects to them.

features.name: Fort wall, north
features.note: Tower to the ruin pieces at the gate. The ruin pillars are the only opening.

features.name: Fort wall, west and south
features.note: Tower along the rim, round the south tip, into the House. Replaces the old outcrop-edge blocker.

features.name: Fort wall, east
features.note: House to SM_Ruin_04 along the rim; the Company cliff rocks stop at outcrop height.

features.name: Fort tower
features.note: Stone tower on the north-west corner.

features.name: Tutorial cave
features.note: The GDD's nearby cave. It teaches dungeon exploring and looting.

features.name: Sealed cleft
features.note: Narrow open-air passage from the quarry to Ruins 2, closed by a planks-and-rubble blocker until quest-002.

features.name: Hunting camp
features.note: Clearing at the trail's end, inside the hunting grounds.

features.name: Ruins arch
features.note: Centre of the lip ruins, on the sight corridor from the tents. The arch stands just north of this point, square to the tents, so (127, 143) stays open in front of it.

options: New north-west gate replaces the Civilization gate
decisions.value: New north-west gate replaces the Civilization gate

decisions.label: Camp fence
options: Low fence only, as in the design doc

notes:
Valley layout, camp interior still open.
- River rises as a spring or waterfall in the eastern mountains, runs through the lake and leaves by the western pass. No exit through the mountains.
- Fight Club Hollow: rock fold hides it from the fort.
- Ruins ridge must read from the tents at about 200 m.
- Ruins 2: extra ruins in and hidden around the quarry; the sealed passage connects to them.
- Quarry and wood roads join the camp at the current centre; revisit with the camp layout.
- Hand-sculpted heights live in terrain-sculpt.bin next to this file: Tools/World/Capture Area 1 Terrain Sculpt saves them, and the terrain tool reapplies them.
- Valley grown to 1000 m (2026-11-04): the mountain wall moved out to a 700 m valley and the quarry, Ruins 2, wood camp, hunting grounds and river ends moved out; the camp and the sites near it did not move.
